stem:
Ekta lowers a closed empty plastic bottle into a bucket of water. The bottle feels lighter in the water than in the air, and it tends to move upward.

Why does the immersed bottle feel lighter?

options.text: The water applies an upward force on the bottle equal to the weight of the water it displaces.
The water removes the downward pull of Earth on the bottle.
The mass of the bottle decreases while it is in the water.
The water applies only a downward force on the bottle.

teacher.key_rationale: An immersed object feels an upward force from the liquid equal to the weight of liquid displaced; Earth's pull still acts. B drops that gravity still acts. C swaps mass for the force effect. D reverses the direction of the liquid force.
